# gyro_ssh_key (Resource)

An account-level SSH public key that can be installed on new gyro_server resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label, 1-64 characters.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key (ssh-ed25519, ecdsa-sha2-*, ssh-rsa >= 2048 bit).

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_ssh_key.laptop 12
```
